preserved_semantics: Learning is advisory and does not itself grant execution authority.
Unknown denominators remain unknown and are never imputed.
Objective-conditioned/contextual memory prevents silent cross-domain generalization.
Only train-partition experience updates value memory; confirm and evaluation-only partitions do not train.
Policy consideration requires minimum train evidence plus independent confirm evidence.
Single anecdotes do not establish strategy superiority.
Failures eligible for repair require reproducibility and evidence.
Realized revenue/customer value and verified downstream outcomes outrank repository popularity or internal activity.
Overfit and confirm-regression signals remain explicit rather than being averaged away.
